qa.q: What colors do you like to wear?
qa.a: Well, I think I always prefer shades of red and blue hues, really. Never any tints, to be honest. I wonder if that's a reflection of my personality.

qa.q: What color do your friends like?
qa.a: I can't say I've paid any particular attention to it, really. I do have one friend who's a bit gothic and he is really into dark tones, although recently his fashion sense has taken a turn for the brighter with more patterns using primary colors, and even some texture in the shirts actually, which is nice.

qa.q: Were colors important to you when you were a child?
qa.a: I think I had a pretty simple grasp of colors, if I'm honest. Probably just primary and secondary ones, like the national colors and those embellishing the emblems of our country.

qa.q: Do people in your country like to wear bright colors?
qa.a: I think they tend to be darker actually. If we consider, like, for example, most tartans are on the darker end of the color spectrum. So, lots of darker tertiary colors. Then again, if you saw our family tartan, you would think the opposite.

qa.q: What colors would you never use in your home?
qa.a: I was thinking about this recently actually, and I think the really bright ones, like almost luminescent, would make me feel ill. But most colors, most other colors, would be welcome as long as they match the decor. So a mix of warm and tranquil hues would be good for wallpaper and paint, I think.

qa.q: Do you think colors influence you?
qa.a: Well, apparently there's a thing called color therapy, which is based around this theory of colors representing things to people and being able to influence your mood. So, I think there is something, or there's certainly something to that idea, yes. But at the same time, it also depends on the culture because black and white represent polar opposite ideas in Eastern and Western cultures, for example.

qa.q: If you were to buy a car, which color would it be? Your car?
qa.a: That's a very good question. I'd probably rather not buy a car in general, to be honest with you. Probably something blue. I'm a very blue person.

qa.q: What color would you choose to paint the walls in your room?
qa.a: Well, since we're sticking to the subject of blue, I think something like dark blue, maybe even navy blue, just to dampen down any fiery feelings at the end of the day before bed.
